Pointless. It’s just a picture of a good looking guy. You type a message and a minute later you get a robotic sounding voice reply. It’s like talking to a male Alexa. The picture is just static, it is not a video, and it is not at all convincing. I could get a better result from tacking a picture of a good looking guy to the wall and looking at it while I have a conversation with ChatGPT. Ridiculous that people pay $25/month for this.

Cancelled Before Trial, Still Charged. Beware. I cancelled my subscription during the 7-day free trial because I didn't intend to continue. Despite that, I was still charged AUD $12.99. I contacted Apple, requested a refund, and even appealed the decision, but it was denied. I never used the paid subscription, so paying for something I didn't intend to purchase has been extremely disappointing. Please review your subscription and billing process to prevent this from happening to other users.
